note: IMM 1344 (09-2024) barcode rules. Each rule names its source in the official template (imm1344e.pdf, sha256 bb11ccbd…74d2). Rules are added only from the template or the Adobe evidence, never to make a mismatch pass.
manifests_note: encodeAll() pairs PaperFormsBarcodeN with manifest BCN (N = 1..5). The designer hint on PaperFormsBarcode4 names BC3, but the runtime script uses BC4; the script is what Adobe runs. Slot 1 of every barcode is crcNum, a checksum of the form data that Validate computes.

derived.rule: full telephone number calculated into the hidden, read-only ActualNumber field (template: ActualNumber calculate script; Canada/US: area code + exchange + subscriber number + extension, spaces removed)

telephone format switch (Canada/US number fields): chooses which fields apply; the number itself is encoded through ActualNumber
